name: bashrc-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: appends a snippet to a shell rc file so it runs in interactive shells -- target a user's ~/.bashrc or the system-wide /etc/bash.bashrc. Idempotent via MARKER. Vars: TARGET_FILE (required, absolute path), SNIPPET (required, shell text), MARKER (optional distinctive substring for the idempotency grep, default SNIPPET).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${TARGET_FILE:?TARGET_FILE is required (absolute path)}"
: "${SNIPPET:?SNIPPET is required}"

if [ ! -f "$TARGET_FILE" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$TARGET_FILE")"
    : > "$TARGET_FILE"
fi
if ! grep -Fq -- "${MARKER:-$SNIPPET}" "$TARGET_FILE"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$SNIPPET" >> "$TARGET_FILE"
fi
